# CANDIDATE: RSI_DIVERGENCE_VWAP_RECLAIM_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Bullish RSI divergence on the 5-minute chart signals weakening downward momentum; when price subsequently reclaims VWAP with a bullish bar (close > open), the combination indicates a high-probability mean-reversion long setup. This edge exists because RSI divergence often precedes short-term exhaustion, and VWAP reclaim confirms institutional participation resuming the prior trend.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Scan the last three 5-minute lows for a bullish RSI divergence (price makes a lower low, RSI(14) makes a higher low). On the next 5-minute bar, if the close is above VWAP and the close is above the open, enter long at the next bar open.  
**Exit:** Initial stop placed at the swing low that formed the divergence (chart-stop). Target at 2R (twice the risk) or use a trailing premium-stop of 15% of entry price activated after 1R profit is achieved.
